text: The normal renal ultrasound rules out renal causes for the anemia, and the macrocytosis (high MCV) with low hemoglobin in a 1-month-old premature infant is classic for anemia of prematurity due to decreased erythropoietin production. speaker: Doctor
text: The normal erythropoietin level is unexpected for classic anemia of prematurity, which typically shows low EPO. text: The normal ABG and glucose levels rule out acute respiratory or metabolic crises. I need to evaluate for central causes of apnea and anemia, such as a brainstem lesion or intracranial hemorrhage, so I will request neuroimaging. REQUEST IMAGES
